You export transactions from your bank as a CSV file.
Ledger adds each transaction to a ledger file on your computer.
If you import the same CSV file twice, Ledger skips transactions it has already added.
Your data stays on your computer, with no account, no upload, and no subscription.
Ledger is free and open source under the MIT licence.
Ledger works with exports from Sberbank, Tinkoff, and Revolut.
Exports from other banks need a column mapping.
